placements.title: Stated arrangements become settled when they are ratified together on the call
placements.frame: Which concrete arrangement was stated here, who stated it, and what act turned it from a claim into a settled decision?
placements.why: The graph is empty, so nothing existing can be reused. The theme is how planning calls settle arrangements, which later calls will keep feeding. It is a theme and not a fact: the individual facts stay in the position as evidence.
